drawings.description: feuillet de croquis écrit en tous sens (la page se lit tournée d'un quart de tour), couvert de flèches, de cadres et de traits de renvoi, en partie barré. On n'en donne que les fragments lisibles, dans l'ordre du haut vers le bas
drawings.kind: sheet of sketches written in all directions
drawings.notes: Whole sheet, kept in page orientation; coordinates re-read on two tight views of the sheet, labels at \small (drawing at 2 mm per crop unit, about the size of the sheet). Drawn: the two heavy arrows G -> G' (the upper one followed by a second heavy arrow), Hom(... k'; G) = G' at the top, G and R_1 subset G_1, the extension k_0(t^{1/p}) | k_0(t), R'; the small frame below the lower G -> G'; L_1 = L' (fraktur, as in the transcription), the double cone beside it, the brackets of [B_0 = B'_0] (the right one heavy), B, B' contains T, and the long frame open on the left that holds all three; the arrow marked ? down to B = B'; en car. different from 2, 3, 5 (underlined) and O.K.; the boxed L = L' (its right side heavy); the frame at the bottom right that holds the marginal note; in the left columns the heavy arrows read as the Uparrow (drawn pointing left, as on the unturned sheet), the Updownarrow, and a double arrow pointing left at the bottom. Left out: all the text written along the turned sheet and the formulas H^1(...) (they are in the transcription), the long reference lines and the large arcs crossing the sheet, the struck parts (the scribble under the lower G -> G', the hatched arrow at the bottom left, the struck words), the heavy isolated letters (B, R, H, G g B near the right edge, H1 at the left of the double cone) which the transcription does not read, and the contents of the small frame. Still differs: a whole page with its reference lines omitted; positions read on views of half the sheet, drift of 1 to 2 units likely. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: schéma d'implications sur deux rangées, que l'on résume : en haut « (iii') $\Leftrightarrow$ (i) $\Rightarrow$ (i') $\Leftrightarrow$ (ii) », suivi d'un « $\Leftrightarrow$ (iii') » biffé ; en bas « (iii) $\Leftrightarrow$ (i'') ». Entre les deux rangées, des flèches obliques dont plusieurs sont barrées en zigzag, deux portant « triviale » et une « \uncertain{inutile} » ; une grande courbe « triviale » joint (iii') à (iii). Des traits obliques renvoient aux lignes de droite : « \ill{} \uncertain{que} \uncertain{ce} \uncertain{ne} \uncertain{sont} \uncertain{pas} \uncertain{des} \uncertain{conditions} \ill{} », « \ill{} \uncertain{des} \ill{} \uncertain{du} \uncertain{nuage}\,? » et, biffé, « \uncertain{réalisations} de $T_1$ en $\Gamma_1$ \uncertain{et} $T_1$ »
drawings.kind: scheme of implications on two rows
drawings.notes: Upper row (iii') <=> (i) => (i') <=> (ii), lower row (iii) <=> (i''), labels at \small (drawing at 2 mm per crop unit, so that the labels keep the proportion of his writing). Between the rows the three arrows that are not struck, each a double arrow: (iii') region down to (iii), (i'') up to (i') with "triviale", up to (ii). "inutile" (uncertain in the transcription) is placed where it is written, between the struck arrows and the arrow marked "triviale". The large curve "triviale" starts under the heading Dem., runs down to the left of (iii') and passes just above (iii) to end at (i''), as on the facsimile. The reference lines: the curve from above (i) joining the upper line at the end of the row, the upper line, the lower line from (i''), and the four oblique lines, each starting on the upper line. Left out: the struck "<=> (iii')" after (ii), the two zigzag-struck arrows between (i) and (i') and their zigzags, the heading Dem., and the text on the right (it is in the transcription). Still differs: the lower line runs through the struck words "realisations de T_1 en Gamma_1 et T_1" and may be their strike-out rather than a reference line; it is kept, from (i'') to the end of those words. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: en haut à droite, un petit dessin barré portant « $x^2 = a$ », « $x^2 - a + y^2 = 0$ » et « $x/t$ »
drawings.notes: The vertical stroke (slightly curved) and, to its right, the three formulas as the transcription reads them: x^2 = a, x^2 - a + y^2 = 0, x/t, at \small. The whole sketch is struck through with zigzags and loops; following the convention, the strike-out is not drawn. Still differs: the overinked mark at the top of the stroke (an arrowhead or a letter, like an A) and the heavily overinked label to the left of the stroke at the height of the second formula (x^4 ?) are not read and are left out. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.
